# War Scroll Column 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** complete

---

**11:1** You are a terri[ble] God in the glory of Your kingdom, and the congregation of Your holy ones is in our midst as an eternal help. We shall heap contempt upon kings, scorn and mockery upon

**11:2** mighty men. For the Lord is holy, and the King of Glory is with us, together with the holy ones. Valiant warriors of the angelic host are among our ranks,

**11:3** and the Hero of War is in our congregation; the host of His spirits marches with our steps. Our horsemen come like clouds

**11:4** and like mist of dew covering the earth, like a torrent of rain showering justice upon all her growth. Arise, you

**11:5** who lie in the dust! Worms of the dead, lift yourselves up! Gird yourselves and stand! For who is like Your people Israel, whom You chose

**11:6** for Yourself from all the peoples of the earth? A people of the holy ones of the covenant, instructed in the Torah, wise in understanding,

**11:7** who hear the voice of the Honored One and behold the holy angels, whose ears are opened, who hear deep things and perceive the design of

**11:8** the ages of eternity. We shall heap contempt upon kings, mockery and scorn upon mighty men. For the Lord

**11:9** is holy, and the King of Glory is with us, together with the holy ones. Valiant warriors of the angelic host are among our numbered ones, and the Hero

**11:10** of War is in our congregation; the host of His spirits is with our steps. Our horsemen come like clouds, like mist

**11:11** of dew covering the earth, like a torrent of rain showering justice upon all her growth. For the God of Israel has called forth

**11:12** a sword against all the nations, and through the holy ones of His people He shall do mighty deeds. Arise, O Hero! Take

**11:13** Your captives, O Glorious One! Gather Your spoil, O Worker of valor! Set Your hand upon the neck of Your enemies

**11:14** and Your foot upon the heaps of the slain. Strike the nations, Your adversaries, and let Your sword devour

**11:15** guilty flesh. Fill Your land with glory and Your inheritance with blessing; abundance of cattle in Your territory,

**11:16** silver and gold and precious stones in Your palaces. O Zion, rejoice greatly! Shine forth in songs of joy,

**11:17** O Jerusalem! Exult, all you cities of Judah! Open your gates continually, that the wealth of the nations may be brought in to you. Their kings shall serve you, and all your oppressors shall bow before you, and they shall lick the dust of your feet. To You belongs the dominion, and in Your hand is the battle of all.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 11 is the great thanksgiving hymn for God's power in battle. SOPHIA adopted "Hero of War" (EMET/LOGOS) over "Divine Warrior" (PNEUMA) as the more faithful rendering of the Hebrew gibbor milchamah. "Valiant warriors of the angelic host" preferred over "Heaven's fiercest warriors" (PNEUMA). The liturgical repetition in lines 1-4 and 8-11 is preserved identically across all three agents. Closing lines echo Isaiah 60:11-14. 15 disagreements logged.*
